title: Tap the Tin Pan
lines: Nan sat at a tin pan. Tap, tap!
Sam sat at a tan pan. Pat, pat!
Pam is in a nap at the mat.
Nan and Sam sit. Tap the mat, Nan.
Pam sat! Pam is at the tin pan.
Tap it, Pam! Pat it, Nan! Tap, Sam!
Nan and Sam and Pam tap and tap.

questions.ask: What was Pam doing while Nan and Sam tapped?
questions.listenFor: Having a nap. Line three says it. If your child is not sure, let them reread that line rather than being told.

questions.ask: What did Nan tap once she sat down?
questions.listenFor: The mat, which is much quieter than a tin pan. Line five says it.

questions.ask: Why do you think Nan and Sam stopped tapping the pans? Tell me what you think.
questions.listenFor: There is no wrong answer. You are listening for a reason of their own, like they did not want to wake Pam up.
